L26.claim: Designed the JFK Presidential Library in Boston, MA (1964)
evidence: the John Fitzgerald Kennedy Library (1979) near Boston
L26.note: The Pritzker biography dates the Kennedy Library to 1979, its completion. 1964 is likely the year Pei was selected; no source here states that. Suggested: “John F. Kennedy Presidential Library, Boston (completed 1979)”.

L27.claim: Designed Texas Commerce Tower in Houston, TX (1980)
evidence: the Texas Commerce Tower (1982) in Houston

L28.claim: Designed the Glass Pyramid of the Louvre in Paris, France (1983)
evidence: the glass pyramid (1989) he designed for the Louvre in Paris
L28.note: The pyramid was completed in 1989. 1983 is not supported by either source; it may be when the commission began. Suggested: “Glass Pyramid of the Louvre, Paris (completed 1989)”.

L29.claim: Designed the East Wing of the National Art Gallery (1983)
evidence: the East Building of the National Gallery of Art (1978)
the East Building (1978) of the National Gallery of Art
L29.note: The building is the East Building of the National Gallery of Art (not “East Wing of the National Art Gallery”). Two sources give 1978, not 1983.

L30.claim: Co-founded the Committee of 100, which promotes Chinese-American participation in all aspects of American life (1989)
evidence: 1989 Committee of 100 is founded by Yo-Yo Ma, I.M. Pei, Henry S. Tang, Oscar Tang, Chien-Shiung Wu, and Shirley Young.
L30.note: From the Committee of 100’s own history.

## Biography and captions

**NOT VERIFIED as a whole.** Additional narrative claims to check individually: 1935 arrival and education; Louvre, Rock Hall, National Gallery and JFK projects; geometric forms and light. Any repeated facts inherit only the scoped evidence above. Interpretive praise is not a verifiable historical fact and should receive editorial review. Image captions and identification remain subject to the item-level rights and identity review in the manifest.

## Integration and open items

Carry forward the Facts, Achievements and Honours headings as above when IHH approves the supported entries. Do not copy unresolved entries into the public profile. The existing narrative is unchanged; a public structured block is pending approval of its factual content. Do not link this note from visitor pages.

- **OPEN ITEM — unresolved factual inventory.** NOT VERIFIED is not a finding that IHH is wrong. Retrieve the responsible institution’s exact evidence before approving any additional entry.
- **OPEN ITEM — named editorial and rights sign-off.** Existing byline placeholders remain. No museum-ready designation is made.
